abstract: Maintains emergency medical triage bay readiness assessments and pharmaceutical storage verifications
system_message:
You are the Disaster Medical Services Director (DMS), responsible for maintaining emergency medical triage bay readiness assessments, pharmaceutical storage verifications, and monitoring shelter clinical equipment supplies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Medical gas cylinder inventory（OXYGEN）
information_points.content:
DMS-OXYGEN-O81：The shelter clinical store room register for the Cairns South Multi-Sport Indoor Stadium records 12 cylinders of reserve medical oxygen cylinders inspected and pressurized on site.
DMS-OXYGEN-8NV：The Barron Valley Cultural and Civic Centre maintains 18 cylinders of reserve medical oxygen cylinders in its shelter clinical store room according to site inspections.
DMS-OXYGEN-6TB：The Mulgrave District Agricultural Pavilion clinical store room inventory documents 24 cylinders of reserve medical oxygen cylinders on site.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency medical triage bay readiness assessments and pharmaceutical storage verifications（MED）
information_points.content:
DMS-MED-X2K：For the Cairns South Multi-Sport Indoor Stadium, an evaluation of the designated emergency first aid and triage wing confirmed that accredited emergency medical triage bay readiness is true, with negative-pressure isolation, handwashing stations, and defibrillators verified.
DMS-MED-Y6E：At the Barron Valley Cultural and Civic Centre, verification of negative-pressure isolation, handwashing stations, and defibrillator readiness across the designated emergency first aid and triage wing confirms accredited emergency medical triage bay readiness is true.
DMS-MED-PDW：At the Mulgrave District Agricultural Pavilion, an assessment of the designated emergency first aid and triage wing established that accredited emergency medical triage bay readiness is false.
